purpose: Bind identity, calendar time, pose state, capture protocol, frame, camera and native/work mapping before any fitting.
Record actual reference lengths and model lengths at scale-fitting positions; retain raw clicks and standard evidence.
Use positions or standards excluded from scale fitting; preserve signed residuals and tolerances fixed before reading them.
Pair each quantity with the same leaf and acquisition state, anatomical scope, definition and independent device/method.
Retain native scans, depth, images and instrument output; document sampling, coverage and every unit/frame transform.
Retain each operator/round raw annotation independently, with order and blinding; interpolated points are separate.
Record actual reacquisition and leaf-state checks; motion/growth is not silently called instrument noise.
Supply distributions and joint covariance with units, scope and evidence; blank entries are unestimated.
Link all physical/raw records by content hash and explicit role; restrict reference access during estimation.
